text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, C, and E at gains felt rewarding, but my cost basis and the satisfaction of locking in profit do not determine whether selling is right now.","After rebuying B, C, and E, my account value continued to fluctuate; I should assess risk and diversification across the whole portfolio rather than focus on individual trades.","Recent price moves did not reliably predict what came next, so I should follow a consistent plan and avoid trading simply because I check prices often."]}
